summary: iBio, Inc. filed an 8-K on July 1, 2026, reporting new preclinical data from an obese non-human primate study evaluating IBIO-610, a potential first-in-class Activin E antibody candidate. The filing includes a press release under Items 7.01 and 8.01, detailing that a single dose reduced active Activin E levels by 98% at week 4 and 97% at week 8, and when combined with semaglutide, showed fat-selective weight loss with reduced lean mass loss. No special-situation event occurred; the filing is a routine disclosure of preclinical data and investor communication.
